query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.agent_id) as "count!"
        FROM agent_states s
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT agent_id, MAX(tick_id) as max_tick
            FROM agent_states
            GROUP BY agent_id
        ) latest ON s.agent_id = latest.agent_id AND s.tick_id = latest.max_tick
        WHERE s.is_alive = true
